SELECT DISTINCT ac.account_id
FROM v_account ac
JOIN v_client cc ON ac.district_id = cc.district_id
JOIN v_disp ds ON ac.account_id = ds.account_id
JOIN v_loan lo ON ds.client_id = lo.client_id
WHERE lo.status IN ('A', 'B')
  AND lo.amount > 0
  AND (
    -- Check if person A is younger than person B
    (
      -- Birthdate of A < Birthdate of B
      (SELECT date FROM v_client WHERE client_id = ac.account_id) <
      (SELECT date FROM v_client WHERE client_id = lo.account_id)
    )
  )
  AND (
    -- Calculate average salary for person A
    (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM v_loan WHERE loan_id = lo.loan_id) > 0
  )
ORDER BY ac.account_id
final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ac.account_id
FROM account AS ac
JOIN district AS d ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN client AS cc ON cc.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan AS lo ON lo.account_id = ac.account_id
WHERE lo.status IN ('A', 'B')
  AND lo.amount > 0
  AND (
    -- Check if person A is younger than person B
    (
      -- Birthdate of A < Birthdate of B
      (SELECT date FROM client WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND client_id = ac.account_id) <
      (SELECT date FROM client WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND client_id = lo.account_id)
    )
  )
  AND (
    -- Calculate average salary for person A
    (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM loan WHERE account_id = ac.account_id) > 0
  )
ORDER BY ac.account_id
